commitResults.messageTitle: Add parsers for remark and unremark commands
commitResults.messageBody:
Implement RemarkCommandParser and UnremarkCommandParser to support
parsing of remark addition and remark deletion by student index.

This enables the CLI to handle `remark INDEX r/REMARK` and
`unremark INDEX r/REMARK_INDEX` inputs consistently with existing
AB3-style command parsing.
